basic.name: 普通攻击：砸扁，粉碎
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害；
当珂蕾妲拥有[熔炉升温]效果时，能够在第二段攻击后发动强化[普通攻击]，消耗[熔炉升温]效果并造成大量火属性伤害；
强化[普通攻击]分为两段，发动第一段后点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第二段，且第一段强化[普通攻击]的追击效果增强；
[熔炉升温]效果最多可拥有2层，发动强化[普通攻击]会消耗所有的[熔炉升温]；
消耗[熔炉升温]时，全队代理人造成的伤害提升35%，持续40秒，重复触发刷新时间，且每消耗一层[熔炉升温]，第二段强化[普通攻击]造成的伤害提升10%，造成的失衡值提升20%；
第一段强化[普通攻击]发动期间切换代理人，珂蕾妲会在前台自动发动第二段强化[普通攻击]；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，发动强化[普通攻击]，且未在第一段强化[普通攻击]期间切换代理人时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
[普通攻击]第四段和强化[普通攻击]发动期间拥有无敌效果；
第二段强化[普通攻击]无敌效果持续时间增加。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.
When Koleda has the Furnace Fire effect, she can launch an enhanced Basic Attack after the 2nd hit, consuming the Furnace Fire effect and dealing massive Fire DMG.
Enhanced Basic Attack consists of two hits. After performing the first hit, press or hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with the second hit. The pursuit effect of the enhanced Basic Attack's first hit is also strengthened.
Furnace Fire can stack up to 2 times. Performing an enhanced Basic Attack consumes all stacks of Furnace Fire.
When Furnace Fire is consumed, all Agents deal 35% more damage for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Furnace Fire consumed, the second hit of the enhanced Basic Attack deals 10% more damage and inflicts 20% more Daze.
When switching Agents during the first hit of the enhanced Basic Attack, Koleda remains on-field and automatically launches the second hit of the enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in the squad, using an enhanced Basic Attack without switching Agents during the first hit of the enhanced Basic Attack causes the two to perform a Coordinated Attack, further increasing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th hit of her Basic Attack and her enhanced Basic Attack.
The invulnerability duration of the second hit of her enhanced Basic Attack is increased.

special.name: 特殊技：爆破！铁锤时间
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
对前方进行打击并引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第二、第四段或强化[普通攻击]后，则能够快速发动招式，直接引发爆炸；
第二段[普通攻击]发动期间，长按 【普通攻击键】 也可直接引发爆炸；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，并衔接在强化[普通攻击]后快速发动招式时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill launches faster and directly triggers the explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack.
During the 2nd hit of her Basic Attack, holding [Basic Attack] can also trigger the explosion directly.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad, and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：沸腾熔炉
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
对前方进行打击并引发强力爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害，并获得[熔炉升温]效果；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第二、第四段或强化[普通攻击]后，则能够快速发动招式，直接引发爆炸，通过该方式引发爆炸造成的失衡值提升10%；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，并衔接在强化[普通攻击]后快速发动招式时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接[冲刺攻击：给我颤抖]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers a powerful explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Koleda also gains the Furnace Fire effect.
This skill activates faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack. Explosions triggered this way inflict 10% more Daze.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with Dash Attack: Tremble!.

dodge.name: 闪避：走着瞧
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：给我颤抖
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行打击，造成物理伤害。
招式发动期间，若持有[熔炉升温]，抗打断等级提升，长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接强化[普通攻击]。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Performs a forward strike, dealing Physical DMG.
During this skill, if Koleda has Furnace Fire, its Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. Hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with an enhanced Basic Attack.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：别小看我
dodgeCounter.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Don't Look Down on Me
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动打击并引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，若持有[熔炉升温]，长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接强化[普通攻击]。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and creates an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. If Koleda has Furnace Fire, hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with an enhanced Basic Attack.

chain.name: 连携技：天崩-地裂
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
在前方大范围区域发动强力爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害，并获得[熔炉升温]效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：锤进地心
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
在前方大范围区域发动强力爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害，并获得[熔炉升温]效果；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接[冲刺攻击：给我颤抖]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Fire DMG while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect.
Koleda and Ben can team up when fighting together to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with Dash Attack: Tremble!.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：让我来
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：护身锤
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：锤钟
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进打击，造成火属性伤害，并获得[熔炉升温]效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接[冲刺攻击：给我颤抖]。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Koleda charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG and obtaining Furnace Fire effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with Dash Attack: Tremble!.

fields.text: 珂蕾妲发动[强化特殊技]，或消耗[熔炉升温]发动强化[普通攻击]时，招式造成的失衡值提升60%。
fields.textEn: When Koleda uses her EX Special Attack or consumes Furnace Fire to use an enhanced Basic Attack, the Daze she deals increases by 60%.

fields.text:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或[命破]或[锋御]角色时触发：
珂蕾妲发动[强化特殊技]引发爆炸命中敌人时，对目标施加减益效果；当目标陷入失衡状态后，[连携技]对其造成的伤害提升35%，最多叠加2层，失衡状态结束时该效果重置。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture or Armorer character, or shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When the explosion from Koleda's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, it applies a debuff to the target. While the target is Stunned, Chain Attacks deal 35% more DMG to the target. This effect can stack up to 2 times and resets when the Stunned effect ends.

fields.name: 普通攻击：砸扁，粉碎
fields.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害；
当珂蕾妲拥有[熔炉升温]效果时，能够在第二段攻击后发动强化[普通攻击]，消耗[熔炉升温]效果并造成大量火属性伤害；
强化[普通攻击]分为两段，发动第一段后点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接第二段，且第一段强化[普通攻击]的追击效果增强；
[熔炉升温]效果最多可拥有2层，发动强化[普通攻击]会消耗所有的[熔炉升温]；
消耗[熔炉升温]时，全队代理人造成的伤害提升35%，持续40秒，重复触发刷新时间，且每消耗一层[熔炉升温]，第二段强化[普通攻击]造成的伤害提升10%，造成的失衡值提升20%；
第一段强化[普通攻击]发动期间切换代理人，珂蕾妲会在前台自动发动第二段强化[普通攻击]；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，发动强化[普通攻击]，且未在第一段强化[普通攻击]期间切换代理人时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
[普通攻击]第四段和强化[普通攻击]发动期间拥有无敌效果；
第二段强化[普通攻击]无敌效果持续时间增加。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.
When Koleda has the Furnace Fire effect, she can launch an enhanced Basic Attack after the 2nd hit, consuming the Furnace Fire effect and dealing massive Fire DMG.
Enhanced Basic Attack consists of two hits. After performing the first hit, press or hold [Basic Attack] to follow up with the second hit. The pursuit effect of the enhanced Basic Attack's first hit is also strengthened.
Furnace Fire can stack up to 2 times. Performing an enhanced Basic Attack consumes all stacks of Furnace Fire.
When Furnace Fire is consumed, all Agents deal 35% more damage for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Furnace Fire consumed, the second hit of the enhanced Basic Attack deals 10% more damage and inflicts 20% more Daze.
When switching Agents during the first hit of the enhanced Basic Attack, Koleda remains on-field and automatically launches the second hit of the enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in the squad, using an enhanced Basic Attack without switching Agents during the first hit of the enhanced Basic Attack causes the two to perform a Coordinated Attack, further increasing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th hit of her Basic Attack and her enhanced Basic Attack.
The invulnerability duration of the second hit of her enhanced Basic Attack is increased.

fields.name: 特殊技：爆破！铁锤时间
fields.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
fields.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
对前方进行打击并引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第二、第四段或强化[普通攻击]后，则能够快速发动招式，直接引发爆炸；
第二段[普通攻击]发动期间，长按 【普通攻击键】 也可直接引发爆炸；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，并衔接在强化[普通攻击]后快速发动招式时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill launches faster and directly triggers the explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack.
During the 2nd hit of her Basic Attack, holding [Basic Attack] can also trigger the explosion directly.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad, and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，长按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接[冲刺攻击：给我颤抖]。
